description: Detailed record of one Indonesian statute or executive instrument from the House of Representatives (DPR RI) register: number, year, enactment/promulgation dates, an Indonesian abstract with drafting notes, the responsible DPR commission, the Status list (which earlier laws it amends or revokes, which later laws amend it, and which ARTICLES the Constitutional Court / Mahkamah Konstitusi struck down, with case numbers), the table of implementing regulations per article, and the PDF. Use for "which articles of UU 13/2003 were annulled by the Constitutional Court", "implementing regulations of the Cipta Kerja law", "abstract of UU 1/2026".

dpr_id.description: DPR register id from idn_list_statutes, e.g. "1771" (UU 11/2020 Cipta Kerja) or "196" (UU 13/2003 Ketenagakerjaan).

type.description: One of: uu, perpu, pp, perpres, keppres, inpres, perdpr (default uu).

name: idn_statute_detail
title: Idn Statute Detail
